newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE MARKET NOT TRADING - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE MARKET NOT TRADING - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. The latest established market was $65.00 per cwt on Wednesday.

Thursdays packer bids were $64.00, asking prices $65.00-$68.00. There were 66,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 27,200 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - None
